briefings.title: AMD Acquires Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 Billion
briefings.tldr: AMD is acquiring AI startup World Labs in an $8.2 billion all-stock transaction to integrate its spatial and physical intelligence models with AMD's hardware, software, and systems stack.

briefings.title: Why World Models Could Change Robotics, 3D, and Creativity
briefings.tldr: World Labs co-founders unveiled Atlas, a next-generation world model that unifies pixel generation and 3D reconstruction through "new view prediction," allowing users to generate novel perspectives, 3D spaces, and simulations from sparse input cameras.

briefings.title: What's Beyond ChatGPT? The 'Godmother of AI' Has a Plan | The Circuit
briefings.tldr: Fei-Fei Li—known as the "Godmother of AI"—has launched World Labs, a startup betting on world models and spatial intelligence to push AI beyond chatbots.

briefings.title: Solving the Hardest Problem in Robotics | World Labs with a16z

people.name: Yunzhu Li
people.role: Co-founder, SceniX and Assistant Professor, Columbia University

briefings.tldr: World Labs acquired SceniX to build a real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that combines World Labs' generative world models with SceniX's simulation and robotics stack, tackling the fundamental robotics bottlenecks of data scarcity and offline evaluation.

briefings.title: World Labs' Fei-Fei Li on Creating Large World Models
briefings.tldr: World Labs Co-Founder and CEO Fei-Fei Li is betting on "spatial intelligence" over traditional Large Language Models (LLMs), developing simulator-class Large World Models (LWMs) to bridge the gap between digital text and physical-world AI action.

briefings.title: 3D & AI | Dr. Fei-Fei Li, CEO & Co-Founder, World Labs & Jeetu Patel

people.name: Jeetu Patel
people.role: Executive Vice President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco

briefings.tldr: Dr. Fei-Fei Li, CEO & Co-Founder of World Labs, asserts that spatial intelligence – the ability for AI to understand and interact with the 3D/4D physical world – is the next critical frontier for AI, unlocking advanced applications beyond current language models.

briefings.title: 3D & AI | Dr. Fei-Fei Li, CEO & Co-Founder, World Labs
briefings.tldr: Dr. Fei-Fei Li, CEO & Co-Founder of World Labs, positions spatial intelligence as the next frontier of AI, essential for machines to understand and interact with the 3D physical world, and introduces "Marble," World Labs' state-of-the-art generative 3D world model with diverse applications.

briefings.title: Fei Fei Li, World Labs CEO: A Fortt Knox Update
briefings.tldr: Dr. Fei Fei Li, CEO of World Labs, asserts AI's status as a pervasive "civilizational technology" impacting every aspect of life, underscoring the critical need for diverse global participation and localized understanding, while identifying spatial intelligence as the next major frontier beyond current language models.
